ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers Library[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
This mod adds no extra functionality by itself, it is a library for all of my mods.
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/tree/development/Build/x64/Release
